title: Estate Surrender Reduction on the Final Amortization of an Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
Where an **Entrance Fee Agreement** ended on the resident's death, an estate that surrenders the apartment promptly earns a surrender reduction subtracted from the percentage of the final period amortized: where the agreement terminated on the resident's death and the apartment was vacated within 15 days after the date of death, the reduction is 0.5 percentage points; where it terminated on death and the apartment was vacated 16 to 30 days after, the reduction is 0.25 percentage points; otherwise there is no reduction.

The reduced percentage is applied to the entrance fee first; the share of the month and the cap at the refundable balance above the floor act on that product.

## Records read

The vacate date of the apartment on the **Independent Living Residency Agreement** paired with the Entrance Fee Agreement, compared with the date of death, which is the termination date of an agreement that ended on death.

## Reduction ladder

| Termination reason | Vacate date compared with the date of death | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Death | Same day up to 15 days after | 0.5 percentage points |
| Death | 16 to 30 days after | 0.25 percentage points |
| Death | More than 30 days after, before the date of death, or not vacated | None |
| Notice or for cause | Any | None |

## Boundaries

| Days from death to vacate | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 15 | 0.5 |
| 16 | 0.25 |
| 30 | 0.25 |
| 31 | None |

## Hypothetical figures

Date of death 1 June, apartment vacated 12 June (11 days): a final-period percentage of 1.5 is reduced to 1.0. Vacated 25 June (24 days): reduced to 1.25. Vacated 5 July (34 days): stays 1.5.
